[1]Charles Booker

Peter, when I look
back on the progress we’ve made, I’m overwhelmed with gratitude.

From becoming the first Black candidate in Kentucky to win the Democratic
primary, to receiving endorsements from iconic progressive leaders like
Bernie Sanders – our campaign is gaining serious momentum. 🔥

We built this campaign from the ground up. When we started, we didn’t have
a million dollars in the bank to fall back on or support from the
political establishment.

But we did have a story. So many of you graciously listened to the story
of my family. I grew up in one of the poorest ZIP codes in Kentucky. Both
of my parents had to drop out of high school to help take care of my
brothers and sisters. We sometimes had to go without heat in the winter or
air conditioning in the summer. My mom often went without eating so that I
could.

Seeing how my story resonated with so many of you was a powerful reminder
that my story isn’t unique at all. Millions of families are still
struggling to reach the same goals and aspirations of my family.

That’s why I’m running to take on Rand Paul and give our families the
representation they deserve in the Senate.

| | | Fellow conservative, When I grew up, the veterans in my community were some of the strongest, bravest people I knew. I knew I wanted to be _just_ like them, so I worked my tail off to get into West Point and graduate to become a U.S. Army Captain. But no matter what you see in Top Gun, serving our country isn’t glamorous. It’s staying long nights out in the elements. It’s a mission where you don’t know what the next day will bring. Whether it’s swallowing your pride and putting your nose to the grindstone, or whether people see your hard work or not. _I may have hung up my uniform, but the work ethic, patriotism, and values of the military are as strong in me as ever before._

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: Big Tech’s campaign of censorship
body:
Our country is currently facing a great threat. A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6049%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=ba%2bmckjg7jfKwmDI%2fnr8MA&sysid=1)
[** **](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62439%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tSSVnwbgdUJ0VTF3WKX97w&sysid=1)
Friend,
**Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history.
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we’ve watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_
[**>> DONATE NOW TO HELP US CONTINUE THE FIGHT <<**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62430%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=M4X4Wdg1iDk1tT5Rg5NJFw&sysid=1)
We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were “mostly peaceful” and “passionate.”
We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn’t align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Friend****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**
Together we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the world and that they have an opportunity to continue making them even greater.
[**If you’ve been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself - the time is NOW.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62431%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MFkoJK25tiH1GKz9wQWyww&sysid=1)
[**If you’re with me,**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62432%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8k%2f6rrYtO8OWZsjLYR%2f2OQ&sysid=1)[**Friend****, chip in any amount to help me defeat this enemy.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62433%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7ALG5Kl12noqTw%2frxMlxpA&sysid=1) I can’t do it without you. I promise you; I will _**never**_ stop fighting.
Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis
[CHIP IN NOW](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62434%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=d216KttcUuujbIt7zUO5Ew&sysid=1)

body:
Thanks for joining the fight for safe and secure elections [](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-r/) Thank you for signing up to receive updates from me and the team and for joining the fight for SAFE and SECURE elections.[_**With your help, we WILL take back our elections and eliminate possible fraud.**_](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-y/) The laws put in place by a handful of extreme liberals in Carson City have made it easier to cheat and harder to get caught.**As Secretary of State, I will make the necessary changes to create a safe and secure environment for elections in Nevada.****The first bill I will send to the Nevada Legislature will be to require a photo ID to vote.** And whether the legislature acts or it doesn't, I will immediately start the process to change our state's constitution to require a photo ID to vote in Nevada. We cannot allow liberal, single party rule to get in the way of something the vast majority of Nevadans agree should be the law.**Here 's how YOU can join the fight for SAFE and SECURE elections:**
1. Join us on social media on **[Twitter](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-j/)** and **[Facebook](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-t/)**.
2. All aspects of what we do -- online and on the ground -- rely on donations to keep us running and spreading the word about bad bills, events, and more. **[Can we count on you to pitch in whatever you can by clicking here?](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-i/)**
3. We have various opportunities to volunteer and need your help online and on the ground. **[Get involved by signing up to volunteer here and we 'll be in touch.](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-d/)**

By requiring Nevada state issued photo identification, we can make sure elections are transparent, fair, and accurate. I believe all Nevadans who are US Citizens should have the opportunity to vote. Together, we will transform Nevada from one of the worst election systems in America to one of the best.Thank you for your support,Jesse Haw [](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-h/) [**P.S. My campaign is COMPLETELY DEPENDENT on grassroots donors like YOU. Can you chip in $5 or $10 to support my campaign?**](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-k/) [DONATE](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-u/) _Jesse Haw is a conservative leader in the Nevada State Legislature. He is the ONLY candidate for Nevada Secretary of State with the experience and background to restore SAFE and SECURE elections in Nevada._ [](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-o/)[](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-l-azjdi-iujiiybq-b/) | [Preferences](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.updatemyprofile.com/y-azjdi-20D6C09D-iujiiybq-n) | [Unsubscribe](https://jessehawforsecretaryofstatenv.cmail19.com/t/y-u-azjdi-iujiiybq-p/)

Peter —

My name is Jonathan Jackson, and I’m running for Congress to represent Illinois’ First District.

I’m no stranger to activism and no stranger to overcoming obstacles. My father, the Rev. Jesse Jackson, has spent his career fighting for social, economic and educational justice, and I grew up learning that giving back to the community was not an isolated action or event – it’s a part of our moral obligation to one another.

I have been fighting for working people my entire life. As a born-and-raised Chicago businessman, college professor, and activist, I have been on the forefront of the struggle for civil and human rights.

Now, I’m running to continue that work in the halls of Congress, where they need some help.

[I’m honored to be on this journey with you, and I want to start by asking you to share your honest thoughts about the issues facing our families, and the change we need to make in Congress.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46452950/350340991/-1269572344?contactdata=QN9Vgzwj%2FwblvsCjVZ8aq38%2Ft20CJYzgVAXIrFwM0Bu6%2FouN%2FlTwkWQ7Fhk1IRLIwQtO2GzINdJQSONabcE1llLd6nmBFF49atth2DkRQVJGquF0u5IahzZ2hqRsMuj7HrDHkEhOW6yUk9U%2F9xSBtYKdCU2bVmiTgVe8mvCCiPU%3D&refcode=JJ_EM_SV_NTL_Welcome_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDlhMWVjZi0xY2ViLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hKmYPDtwPfazA0URkid7Ilh55NEFGcvHCMb1Erv8Gw4=&emci=d816916c-a6cf-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ed9a1ecf-1ceb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239) | | **[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46452951/350340993/-1269572344?contactdata=QN9Vgzwj%2FwblvsCjVZ8aq38%2Ft20CJYzgVAXIrFwM0Bu6%2FouN%2FlTwkWQ7Fhk1IRLIwQtO2GzINdJQSONabcE1llLd6nmBFF49atth2DkRQVJGquF0u5IahzZ2hqRsMuj7HrDHkEhOW6yUk9U%2F9xSBtYKdCU2bVmiTgVe8mvCCiPU%3D&refcode=JJ_EM_SV_NTL_Welcome_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDlhMWVjZi0xY2ViLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hKmYPDtwPfazA0URkid7Ilh55NEFGcvHCMb1Erv8Gw4=&emci=d816916c-a6cf-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ed9a1ecf-1ceb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239)**

There is a time and a purpose and place for everything. And I do believe this is my time to step up and serve the people and help bring about change for our community.

But it’s not enough anymore for me to sit back and run my businesses and help individuals unilaterally and not address these issues on a larger scale. I must do more.

I’ve been fighting for working people my entire life. And I want to expand my efforts by becoming your next Congressman.

I’m running because the people of the First District are hurting. The people of the First District need help. I’m a proud son of Chicago. I love this city and its wonderful people – and I’m ready to fight for you.

If you’re with me, and you’re ready to lower the cost of childcare, increase the minimum wage, and make healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone – **_then I want to hear from you._**

[Join me in this fight by sharing your thoughts about the challenges and opportunities we’re facing.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46452952/350340995/-1269572344?contactdata=QN9Vgzwj%2FwblvsCjVZ8aq38%2Ft20CJYzgVAXIrFwM0Bu6%2FouN%2FlTwkWQ7Fhk1IRLIwQtO2GzINdJQSONabcE1llLd6nmBFF49atth2DkRQVJGquF0u5IahzZ2hqRsMuj7HrDHkEhOW6yUk9U%2F9xSBtYKdCU2bVmiTgVe8mvCCiPU%3D&refcode=JJ_EM_SV_NTL_Welcome_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDlhMWVjZi0xY2ViLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hKmYPDtwPfazA0URkid7Ilh55NEFGcvHCMb1Erv8Gw4=&emci=d816916c-a6cf-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ed9a1ecf-1ceb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239)

Thanks for being a part of this,

Jonathan

* * *

Jonathan is running to create jobs in Illinois, increase workforce skills, and build family economic security, values that Washington could stand to fight for. It's going to take all of us working together to get him to Congress, but if you'd like to receive fewer emails, we understand. For freedom,

Heidi St. John

name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: laughable
body:
Admiral Mike Franken is running for Senate to defeat Chuck Grassley in Iowa. Split a donation between his campaign and CommonGood today and do your part to protect our Democratic Senate majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220613_CGVA_Franken]
Derek,
Well, that didn’t take long. Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began:
*
“The
most
liberal
nominee
in
Iowa
Senate
history”
*
“Radical”
*
“Socialist”
Gotta love it! Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check.
But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.
And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.
These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.
In order to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before midnight tomorrow, but the only way we’ll hit our goal and send Grassley packing is if grassroots donors like you give right now:
Please, can I count on you to split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – every dollar you can afford – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220613_CGVA_Franken]

These attacks against me are ridiculous, but we cannot let them go unanswered.
Thank you for being a crucial part of this phase of our campaign,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)

Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child. And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional. These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network. There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority. In order to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before midnight tomorrow, but the only way we’ll hit our goal and send Grassley packing is if grassroots donors like you give right now: Please, can I count on you to split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – every dollar you can afford – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? body:

Dear Peter,
With just weeks to go until the July 19 primary, our team remains closer to the finish line than any other candidate in this race. We’re in the home-run stretch – and we must keep our foot on the gas.
Ahead of this month’s critical mid-month fundraising deadline, my team has set a fundraising goal of $12,000 to ensure that we have the resources needed to keep firing on all cylinders in this make-or-break period of the race. If you can spare anything, I am urging you to do so today. A flood of grassroots donations can easily get us to our goal, and will go a long way towards securing our victory.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/midmonthjune_0613?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/midmonthjune_0613?amount=20.22]
CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/midmonthjune_0613?amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/midmonthjune_0613?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/midmonthjune_0613]
The Washington Post has said this could be one of the most expensive elections in Maryland’s history. That means the impact of your grassroots donations cannot be overstated. This mid-month fundraising goal is one of the most important of our campaign, as the money we raise right now will feed immediately back into our direct voter contact efforts in these final, critical weeks before election day.
Any amount you can spare will make a huge difference – even just a $10 donation can help us reach over 1,000 Maryland voters online.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for your continued support of this movement. Together, we’re going to win this competitive race by knocking on more doors, placing more phone calls, running more ads, planting more yard signs, handing out more literature, and ultimately securing more votes than any other candidate.
The finish line is in sight – click here to help us reach our $12,000 fundraising goal before our June 15 deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/midmonthjune_0613?amount=20.22]
Thank you,

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

| | [History is against us, team. The party that controls the White House almost always loses seats during the midterms, and the GOP just needs a net gain of 7 seats to win back the House Majority in November.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale
College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the
subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15
years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological
understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary
beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and
introduction by the President of Hillsdale College, Dr. Larry P.
Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at
Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher
education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four
relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and
creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

These relationships are explored in the
narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac,
Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in
your home with your family or for use in small groups such as
Bible studies and book clubs.

For your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more
in support of Hillsdale College, you'll receive the DVD as our
thank you.

To receive your Genesis DVD box set or to
give it as a gift, please use the secure link here:
https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-genesis

As you know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY
PENNY of state and federal government funding-even indirectly
through student loans and grants. That's why your support is so
crucial.

Your gift helps expand Hillsdale College's
national educational outreach efforts to educate millions of
Americans nationwide, including our nation's youth. Your gift
will also help to:

Increase the number of students taking
free online courses, such as "Genesis."
Expand the readership of Imprimis,
Hillsdale's digest of liberty.
Open and support classical K-12 charter
schools through the College's Barney Charter School Initiative.
Promote the principles of American
constitutionalism through social media and the radio.

Friend, please use the secure link above to
make a $100 contribution in support of Hillsdale's educational
outreach, and explore the beauty of the first book of the Bible
with your new DVD set of "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical
Narratives."

Warm regards,

Bill Gray

Associate Vice President of National Donor
Outreach
Hillsdale College

Running for Congress isn’t easy and my schedule is always busy. But even during the most jam-packed days, I find myself thinking about my father, Al Baldus.

My dad was a WW2 and Korean conflict veteran and community servant, through and through. He was a leader for our community in the state legislature, and later in Congress. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46469842/350390446/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.af5e60f1-31eb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.af5e60f1-31eb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjVlNjBmMS0zMWViLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=R0yQhK2P5kGAUxtxjdcu7I1mHtO9KGnjlHNwzLg0O9k=) _My father Al Baldus_ Growing up, I watched my father fight tirelessly for the people of WI-03. I also watched as our community coped with farm loss, economic crises, and inadequate health care. He worked across the aisle to get legislation passed for farmers, small businesses, and our environment.

Today, I still see too many members of the community struggling with the challenges my father tried to combat during his days in Madison and Washington.

**I'm running for Congress because I know we can do more to strengthen our communities and deliver real change for Wisconsin.**

However, our fight won’t be easy. We’re up against a radical Republican insurrectionist backed by Donald Trump and the MAGA machine, running in one of the most competitive districts in the country. Van Orden will not work for Wisconsin.

subject: Three key takeaways from this redistricting cycle:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee
body:
|
---

---
Folks,

With the midterms just a few months away — the first national election to take place on the new maps drawn over the last two years — it’s clear that the work of the NDRC and our affiliates to block unfair maps and defend fair ones made a _big_ difference. Here are three key takeaways from this recent redistricting cycle:
* **First, fairer redistricting has led to fairer maps overall.** 56% of Americans either saw a neutral or net improvement on the fairness of their own congressional district lines, and three-fourths of the states are now entering the decade with fair maps in place.

* **Second, Democrats are in a stronger position compared to the last decade.** There are more Democratic-leaning seats overall, and there’s been a drastic reduction in the additional popular vote margin Democrats likely need to win the House, compared to 2012.

* **Third, Democrats are in a stronger position on the map than even Republicans,** with 226 House districts that would have voted for President Biden in 2020, compared to just 209 districts that voted for Donald Trump.

The bottom line? Democrats not only overperformed in redistricting, but the overall House map is much fairer than before and will stay competitive for _years_ to come. clean_body: | Folks, With the midterms just a few months away — the first national election to take place on the new maps drawn over the last two years — it’s clear that the work of the NDRC and our affiliates to block unfair maps and defend fair ones made a big difference. Here are three key takeaways from this recent redistricting cycle: First, fairer redistricting has led to fairer maps overall. 56% of Americans either saw a neutral or net improvement on the fairness of their own congressional district lines, and three-fourths of the states are now entering the decade with fair maps in place. Second, Democrats are in a stronger position compared to the last decade. There are more Democratic-leaning seats overall, and there’s been a drastic reduction in the additional popular vote margin Democrats likely need to win the House, compared to 2012. Third, Democrats are in a stronger position on the map than even Republicans, with 226 House districts that would have voted for President Biden in 2020, compared to just 209 districts that voted for Donald Trump. The bottom line? Democrats not only overperformed in redistricting, but the overall House map is much fairer than before and will stay competitive for years to come. It’s a big win for our democracy — but our fight isn’t over yet. | = There’s still litigation pending across the country that will affect maps in 2024, and for the rest of this decade. name: Great America Update
subject: For a limited time
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6040%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=5jRes2D6Asg9ZvgVtMlt5w&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62446%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=s6pFvhEHm4q0kFfVzxOQTA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well.
Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time.
How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges?
Well, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_.
Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.
Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.”
That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves.
**So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
_**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more.
The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62447%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=WQsP9rSA%2fv6pvO64nSFexQ&sysid=1) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long.
Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62448%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZD0MbrHVLpBnuXGZWZRTFA&sysid=1)
Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

| Hello Team Diehl Volunteers!
How can you help?
Join our Weekly Meeting:
Wednesday, June 15th at 7:30 a.m. Zoom link: [Volunteer Weekly Meeting](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Zbt_eUnPyqPSPc2pqXhtgBgD7ZL1qNfXNjZV7AKgij5agDkNqCLSBGiqB85X4e4r_64fKm2OxPhcmcTwxal3hmnlvKk60bpcWQwq6v1N8GHMPIAApSXj-xmWBh94ElUGcmW7rq_OjPc0H331mA2t4mnuV-bO5WI3IfsTVBql76RLVR36eeK5wg-PpOqVx4RBlIjCwQqdh3MAPsOrKYlrlmKRT8U559a-kAvk4GTlpV6WQuXbecOcmT8Ag1V71QZlP_RnjNHDtnuX57MSKgXHEud9pxx6ClT0&c=3NI6JRhQtEcFs4PwKuGi2C4aB4iXiMSXGRGV4spU8k0PEXEaysG7Tw==&ch=betfpwF72DKqrLfVGdcnIlLtC-wzKlRh6lA7Vu3o9_fKoCyR04OB1w==). Please join in and share the link with others interested in joining in. This is a recurring link, so save it and jump on the call each Wednesday at 7:30 a.m.
Lawn Sign Depots and Distribution:
We are looking for lawn sign depots(places to house signs for pick up across the state), and people willing to distribute lawn signs to requestors as well. If you can assist with either of these, please contact: amanda@geoffdiehl.com.
Organize a Weekly Sign Standout in Your Community:
We are launching "Saturday Standouts" beginning Saturday, June 25th at 8:30 a.m. Please be the organizer of one in your community. It's easy! Choose a location which is high traffic in your area. Contact us to get signs and banners, and publicize each week locally(on social media, via email, telephone calls, etc.) where people can come and join in. You can provide them the signs when they show up.
Represent the Diehl Campaign in Parades:
Geoff can't be everywhere, so please represent the campaigns by marching with our signage in parades.
Parades are fun, the camaraderie is wonderful, and this is something we haven't seen the last few years. They will be bigger and better than ever! Please RSVP to me to join in: Dedham - Tuesday, June 14th, 6pm Braintree - Saturday, June 25th, 11:45am Plymouth - Monday, July 4th, 9am Duxbury - Monday, July 4th, 2pm Wakefield, Monday, July 4th, 5pm Sudbury, Monday, July 4th 1 p.m.
Work in our Waltham or Plymouth Field Offices:
We are looking for individuals who can be relied upon to open our offices for phone banking, passing out signs, and organizing other volunteer efforts, beginning July 1st. If you live in the area of Waltham and Plymouth, and can commit to 1-2 regular times per week, please let Amanda know: amanda@geoffdiehl.com.

In Michigan. A state where election fraud happened and Trump's victory was stolen...and Biden's DOJ just had me arrested. ** I started this campaign for a simple reason. The government's grip on the throat of its citizenry has grown so tight as to make our republic unrecognizable. When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up. I stood up. And this is what happens when you stand up to tyranny in Biden's America. _I will never bend the knee to tyrants. I don't think you will either. _ There is a simple answer. We beat them. We beat them at the ballot box so badly that they can't cheat. They can't steal it. We beat them so badly that no government, no political party, no deep state operative _**will ever, ever forget the consequence of oppressing the will of the people**_ and attempting to steal our God-given rights. _I_ _need_ _your_ _help_. [I need you to make a donation right now and help me fight back. I have no intention of letting up now. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60576305:JlsbseoEN:m:1:3253819041:87E17D70BA69667A3E9356039661A985:r) That they're trying to throw me in prison shows they're scared. You know what will scare them more? A war chest unrivaled in history. A war chest that says every man and woman across this country who believes in liberty and the rights of the people are standing arm-in-arm ready to defend those rights. You've probably never gotten a letter from a political prisoner, but you're getting one now. The question is: _What will you do next?_ Will you delete this email and go back to your day waiting around for them to take away your next freedom? Maybe your second and first amendment rights next? Or will you [click the link, make a donation, and be part of the true grassroots movement that is building here](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60576305:JlsbseoEN:m:1:3253819041:87E17D70BA69667A3E9356039661A985:r)? I've made it clear where I stand. I will not back down. I will not stop defending OUR rights. Yours and mine. I need you to commit, right now. Click the link, make as generous a donation as you can. **They want us silent. They want us on our knees.** Stand up. Stand with me. Get involved right now, while there is still time.

| | | Matthew McConaughey – a native of Uvalde, Texas, where 19 children and 2 teachers were murdered in their elementary school just weeks ago – is speaking out forcefully against gun violence and demanding action from Congress that is long overdue. McConaughey could have stayed on the sidelines, but he chose to do the right thing and take a stand. Because of this, he is likely to incur boycotts from right-wingers and threats from gun nuts. We want Matthew McConaughey to know how grateful we are for helping shine a spotlight on our country’s gun violence crisis and refusing to put up with Congress’ inaction. [Please join us in thanking Matthew McConaughey for speaking out against gun violence >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdda9dc85-f45a-4293-be83-135696da357c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Florida is currently facing a number of crises, from Ron DeSantis’s ongoing assault on reproductive freedom to his **_refusal_** to pass commonsense gun safety laws.

_**On every conceivable issue, Gov. DeSantis’s actions are making Floridians less safe and less free.**_
* Ron DeSantis _asked_ the Supreme Court to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , and he signed one of the strictest abortion bans ever in Florida.
* He vowed that as governor, he will make sure the law is changed to allow people to carry concealed guns without any sort of permit.

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly-plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **"Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

After we won our primary, our team is more energized than _ever_ to win big this November, and I know you are too.| | | Peter, Being Hung Cao’s campaign manager has been the journey of a lifetime.

After we won our primary, our team is more energized than ever to win big this November, and I know you are too.

But with all the excitement in the air, I wanted to give you an update on our campaign.

We’re almost halfway through June, and we’re not where we need to be to meet our goal for the FEC deadline on the 30th.

I know you get a lot of emails about mid and end of month deadlines, but let me take a moment fo explain why these numbers are so important.

At the end of every month, the FEC publishes fundraising numbers for every race across the country.

These numbers are what people are going to look at to see if we have what it takes to win our critical race.

If we come out with weak numbers, we’ll be left behind in the dust of the news cycle.

But if we CRUSH our goals, the country will see - and our race will be skyrocketed to the national stage.

**We need this race to be front and center if we’re going to pull off the momentum we need to win, and right now, we’re counting on you to step up as a member of Hung’s A-team.**

body:
While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlqf9onsv0kjmnjaq2svu9vv4bveo2h76p2ojrog_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u5r70oji6kpjepdhc3i3cor5miordcr4sgpj8phhm5hjcojm6koe4sj3e2rj0ttnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shlcoobeddjcurm2phgm2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5cli62or0shi649fg)

---
| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zertc0sm30u76lct1tnqkgotbm27neh0qk6ijavo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5chgm6o74chh2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zndmboqh177782og9k6pjtcbh1jg4fj9anbq5gh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5chgm6o74chh2bs)
---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

| | Peter, President Biden was in town purportedly for the fires. But what he’s really doing is trying to boost Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham’s re-election campaign. Biden left Delaware this weekend and is going around the country trying to prop up his failing poll numbers – and those of his loyalists, like MLG. He’s stopping in New Mexico today and I need your help to counter their propaganda by contributing right now. Biden has created the worst inflation in 40 years with his reckless spending and anti oil and gas policies. MLG has been one of his staunchest supporters every step of the way, so it’s no surprise he’s coming to help her failing campaign. It’s critical that voters learn the truth of the Biden/MLG agenda. That’s why I hope you will make your most generous contribution today, so we can counter their false spin. One of the first acts MLG did as governor was to remove the National Guard from the border. Now we have a crisis on our hands, as one New Mexican dies every day from a fentanyl overdose – fentanyl that comes right across the border. Massive caravans are heading to the border right now and part of the Biden plan is to ship illegal immigrants to Albuquerque. But MLG and Biden are pretending the crisis doesn’t exist. Sad to say it’s working – when was the last time you saw a story on our local news about the border crisis? That’s why it’s up to us to inform voters of the truth in our advertising and that costs money. Biden has waged war on the oil and gas industry. MLG has done the same and took it a step further – she passed her own Green New Deal in New Mexico that increased energy costs for all New Mexicans and threatened rolling blackouts this summer. And just last session, she tried to raise gas prices by ANOTHER 35 cents per gallon. The MLG policies are copycat laws from California – a state that now has $10 per gallon gasoline in places. Why is New Mexico modeling our laws after a place that has $10 per gallon gas? And when did you last hear any of that from the media? You won’t. That’s why it’s up to us to raise the money necessary to communicate these facts to voters. Biden has exploded wasteful spending in DC and MLG has done the same here – increasing state government spending by 40%. She’s handed massive taxpayer-funded pay raises for her political insiders and even gave COVID stimulus checks to illegal immigrants. Government has never been bigger and it’s never been richer. But are you better off? The list goes on and on. But we can’t rely on the media to inform the public about these facts. We all know that. It’s up to our campaign to communicate the truth to voters. That’s why I need your help. **[Please contribute today to help us counter the Biden/MLG propaganda machine.](http://links.markronchetti.com/u/click?_t=b07bd752cdb64edc94e23391776d0f53&_m=eb826adb9f294a748c02356a8cd80f69&_e=HqskdyXI6xpfA5y54wOGbVoDEbeqhW3wGyDsqKBTdtQrkSse4rpHcFhBUhTv5D4ulwAu0RGuPLAGhPeQlcggG-AraONI2mUvnnz_bZgWDjqjmHf3tClxDDfjbBlUYFtaeh0Cp6kebSsNG4_1mc9_11hHoRoz8V1rSJMJrZ_VYjIACKDvVZ168aguHqy2DF6YD8Kgw9_jxZ8b8m7J67CuotdAdR_DfN_q-Nnr7uMoR8mLgJ_JCMufeevq8Psfjnf0aUzkob_SEEgBRYVDwvl0xponwdclEQ4s68qV725uRFA712mcAstlG6N_iUoqOMy6PaxKFGPsYnDeHobvkga8fsnLeNpEi2DfmF-xA4ofVuKL0xvg4dq5crHWvbvh2jgRLBHmxZu-OLwEipvM3-7AVdL8YXjsKPe8QJ4xyMEhEt3TT8oqXBnq7E0lTYrkcbnP3SM5okolbE9RvenlXB0dZZYEdDYsJkR-YEpdBO4iRYu03Ep6WNsSu0nwGO_MInZHlHq2lz6o2x3jKBAyq6TEIA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your continued support.

clean_body: | | | = | | Peter, You know by now that I don’t beat around the bush, so I’m just going to be honest: I am going to ask you for money in this email. Frankly, this should be illegal. It should be illegal to need to be born into money or beg for donations to run for office. But we can't change things if we don't elect people who see the problem. I'm fighting to keep self-funded career politicians and dark-money Republicans like Lauren Boebert from letting corporations and conspiracies control our government. And as much as I hate it, I don’t have a chance at winning if I don’t get a boost in fundraising. = I hate getting emails like this, too. The only thing I hate more is having to write them because our political system is so fcked up that the only way to run a successful campaign is to scrape together enough money to compete with trust fund babies and soulless sell-outs that make up the majority of Congress. But with your help, we’re building a movement that believes in moving past the bullshit — making elections and voting fair and accessible; and getting conspiracy-pushing corporate puppets like Lauren Boebert out of office. Love is love, and every New Mexican should be free and empowered to be their full, authentic selves.** Pride started as a way to commemorate the fight for LGBTQ+ rights one year after activists like Marsha P. Last week, the House passed their radical gun control omnibus bill. It will likely not go anywhere in the Senate. However, in the Senate, Democrats say they have ten Republicans (the number needed to bypass any filibuster) on board with a so-called “framework” for a gun control bill that would include incentives for states to pass red-flag laws. So, using your tax dollars to bribe your state government into passing unconstitutional red flag laws. Not good. [**Please use our AlignAct campaign**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) **to tell Senate Republicans to STAND FOR THE 2ND AMENDMENT!** It is unconscionable that there are that many Senate Republicans willing to go along with Democrats’ unconstitutional efforts to implement gun control bit by bit. _We have edited the campaign so that it now only targets Senate Republicans (since the House voted already), and updated the messaging. So, it’s basically a new campaign. If you completed it last week, you should do it again this week, since it is refreshed. We will continue to update it as the situation changes._
---
[TAKE ACTION](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
Finally, as it looks like one of the big parts of the Senate bill will include something about red flag laws, we thought it was a good time to re-send you our guide about how-to fight red flag laws. We will update it with more recent articles, but the core of what you need to know to speak against them and fight them is all perfectly up-to-date and relevant. [**Please read through the red flag laws guide this week, so that you are prepared!**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)**** It includes constitutionally-sound alternatives, so that you have ideas to argue for as well.

We want to give you a heads up about Congressman Palmer’s soon-to-be-filed bill, “Citizen Ballot Protection Act” (CBP Act). This bill will strengthen voter roll integrity by amending the National Voter Registration Act to make clear that a state may impose a proof of citizenship requirement in order to register to vote in a federal election via the NVRA federal form. Once this bill is filed, we will be sure to help you take action to support it.

Meanwhile, a majority of Democrat men [surveyed](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NDMwJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/4v2Upa-i4lEL9G80zYo6RQ) by the Southern Poverty Law Center believe that Democrat leaders are using mass immigration to gain a political majority among voters. According to a new [paper](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-KtnaWzCUmg) by the Center for Immigration Studies, the nation’s foreign-born population reached 47 million in April, compared to 44.7 million when the election occurred in November 2020. The foreign growth rate is twice the rate of the native-born population and the paper attributes two-thirds of the growth to illegal immigration. The authors report that “The administration’s suspension of nearly all interior deportations and the resulting dramatic decline in immigration enforcement, including deportations, plus its refusal to automatically take custody of non-citizens released from jails and prisons have all likely made illegal immigrants feel safer, reducing emigration of those already here and encouraging new illegal immigration.”

According to a [Bureau of land Management report](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1NDMwJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/ZY9RLnF5Ftjpuabu5NCYMw), the new policy will drive down costs for solar and wind projects by 50%. By 2025, the department hopes to permit at least 25,000 megawatts of renewable energy on public lands.

| | [Team, it’s Speaker Pelosi and I’m fired up.

It’s no secret that Republicans and pundits alike think that the future of the House in November is already decided. Republicans have been celebrating as if they’ve won, and pundits have authored articles and joined talk shows saying as much.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The false choice in addressing gun violence
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/email20220613 [secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220613]
Team,
This weekend, I joined brave young people in Lansing, leading the way on the issue of gun violence. This came just three days after I voted for the Protect Our Kids Act, which included my Safe Guns, Safe Kids bill – which requires gun owners to secure their weapons if there’s a child in the home. You can watch my full remarks below:
secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220613 [secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220613]
It was particularly meaningful to have some members of the Oxford community there in Lansing, at the same time the march in Oxford attracted more than 500 people.
As someone who grew up in a gun-owning family and carried a Glock and an M4 during my three tours in Iraq alongside the military, I can tell you that it’s a false choice to say you either believe in responsible gun ownership or believe in keeping our children safe.
The good news is that I’ve heard from more hunters, sportsmen, and other responsible gun owners in the last two weeks than I have in the last four years. They know that keeping guns out of the hands of people with mental illness is critical. They can and should be allies in keeping our children safe, and we need their participation in this moment.
Now, all eyes turn to the Senate. A bipartisan group of Senators appears to have reached a deal on legislation that would increase access to mental health services, close the "boyfriend loophole" to prevent anyone convicted of domestic violence from legally obtaining a gun, provide funding for states to establish red flag laws, and require more comprehensive background checks for people age 18-21, including obtaining juvenile and mental health records.
Does it include everything I want? No, but as I told the crowd on Saturday, I am ready to support any compromise – because moving the needle, even if it’s not all one side wants, is still better than the paralysis we’ve had for decades on this issue.

---
Throughout my career, I've been a committed supporter of gun safety laws to reduce gun violence. I helped pass legislation that tightened Maryland's concealed weapons law, earned an F rating from the NRA, and even took the fight for gun safety to the U.S. Supreme Court. **The number one job of government is to keep people safe, and right now g overnment is not doing its job. **On average, 743 people die by guns in Maryland each year. That's unacceptable. That's why Maryland needs a leader with a background and experience in criminal justice. Someone who has fought crime for decades, and knows what to do to reduce it. My **[Safe Maryland](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/CMxF4nARlf6wAFa1PSfv0jlFmy0tHsxupmAVrXqus7XTsEmUAegbPULqCVpnZ-BzfvBEjeVgZlzRpITo-T1O8aTLCYafa_7RczsDYSv7bdzCeTcjhF2EZ4dnEWNEUsG6wSA6s4RHJRgGmkJdiQyPaqcrTMY0ZsDdndhh69EhOnUY_HoTdjDCft8mQ7MF7AZgg0ChFWcW3h4ucNlCQMpyCXvpeT6kEwU2nFT9HgCRGMvuZ-Ik5EblL2HI8w3_tP1gkVANhEeq9qfrDazzl_4aSWLm5gFxzcQ7PuHJ4Ljc_I_fKlV237EaINjihKvbxrmC6SVGKZt2e-r88ULLOQ6lRKNsaoSIlIn0M2uw8tKP8Ak/3mv/bQyHzznkQiG3IwgjHiegMA/h2/RA77Mvd69AZKpqpxOLneZhAVgkfsp8LlVm61CwZhzvU)** plan to fight violent crime will prioritize gun trafficking and will remove violent offenders from our streets. If you want a governor who will make Maryland safe, who will get guns out of the hands of violent criminals, and who knows what it takes to make change on Day One --_**I ask for your vote.**_ If you can accept this level of gun violence, you should vote for someone else. When I'm elected governor, I promise to use my expertise to tackle this crisis head-on by getting violent criminals and illegal guns off our streets and keeping guns out of the hands of domestic abusers. Thank you, Doug

I helped pass legislation that tightened Maryland's concealed weapons law, earned an F rating from the NRA, and even took the fight for gun safety to the U.S. Supreme Court. The number one job of government is to keep people safe, and right now g overnment is not doing its job. On average, 743 people die by guns in Maryland each year. That's unacceptable. That's why Maryland needs a leader with a background and experience in criminal justice. Someone who has fought crime for decades, and knows what to do to reduce it. My plan to fight violent crime will prioritize gun trafficking and will remove violent offenders from our streets. If you want a governor who will make Maryland safe, who will get guns out of the hands of violent criminals, and who knows what it takes to make change on Day One --I ask for your vote. If you can accept this level of gun violence, you should vote for someone else. When I'm elected governor, I promise to use my expertise to tackle this crisis head-on by getting violent criminals and illegal guns off our streets and keeping guns out of the hands of domestic abusers. | | | **Tanya For Arizona Campaign Round-Up**
This week Tanya met with voters to talk about how she will work to stop the Democrats' out-of-control spending and work to make life more affordable for Arizonans.

Team Tanya is gearing up for a BIG week. We can't wait to fill you in on all of our news and adventures around the district in our next newsletter!

If you want Team Tanya to stop by your group next time or you are interested in volunteering, email us at [info@tanyaforarizona.com](mailto:info@tanyaforarizona.com "mailto:info@tanyaforarizona.com")

**Trends We Are Watching**

The national average surpassed $5 this week for a gallon of gas and inflation hit 8.6% (a *NEW* 40-year HIGH).

Milk is up 15.9% and eggs are up 32.2%.

American families can't afford this and the Democrats don't seem to care. Voters won't forget this when they enter the ballot box...

**In Case You Missed It...

Tanya Called Out the Biden Administration on their Shortcomings in Handling the Baby Formula Crisis**

In Biden's America, gas prices are soaring, rent is through the roof and now babies don't have food. The Biden administration is more focused on finger-pointing than on fixing any of the problems facing American families.

Hear directly from Tanya on the baby formula crisis [HERE](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=2a162eabb3&e=bd2b55b0e3)!

**Tanya in the News...**

Tanya spoke with the **New York Times** about how East Valley’s families are struggling, but they trust Republicans to handle the big issues: economy, border, safety. Read the full article [HERE](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=a9d089bbfc&e=bd2b55b0e3)!

The bipartisan gun safety legislation announced yesterday will save lives.

If passed into law, it would be the first federal gun safety legislation in 30 years, so the NRA will fight tooth-and-nail to stop the bill. And there is little to no margin for error. If we lose even one legislator, this deal could fall apart.

I never thought I’d run for public office.
#

I’ll be honest with you: When Gabby and I got married, I never thought this is the way things would turn out.
I never thought I’d run for public office. She was the elected official in the family — and on the International Space Station, I was about as far from Congress as you can get.

Radical activist teachers brainwashed a 12-year-old girl to think she's a "boy" and hid it from her mother...

So, we're dragging the teachers and school into court to make them pay for their disgusting actions and stop this from happening to other children.

[**But to win this critical case I need your help today. That is why I'm asking you to join me by donating to make sure these radical teachers can't brainwash any more children.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60577318:6mJ-6eozN:m:1:3253819041:D016A2FEBD50DA183253F7AF77A0E551:r)

In case you missed the details of our case when I announced it with Laura Ingraham on her great **Fox News** show **The Ingraham Angle** let me recap it for you.

It’s Time for Us to Secure our State’s Future | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/brnoforaz/june-arizona-in-peril?e=6dcd2506d1)

| Arizonans are struggling under the Biden administration’s complete mismanagement and radical agendas. If you're like me and my family, you don’t need to see any headlines to know something is going terribly wrong—your budget, gas bill, and grocery bill get the point across. A quality life in Arizona is becoming impossible for many to afford. We need real solutions and a true Arizonan fighter, not Senators like Mark Kelly who sit back, do nothing, then blame everyone else for the issues hitting our state.

Don’t get it sideways, Biden’s radical spending is causing inflation and his crusade against the American oil industry has sent our [gas prices into an out-of-control upward spiral](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=637c37db50&e=6dcd2506d1). When Biden took office, Mark Kelly and he successfully [canceled the Keystone XL pipeline](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=ad907a3630&e=6dcd2506d1) which would have brought crude oil from our allies in Canada to American oil refineries for sale here in the U.S. Worse yet, the Biden administration has [canceled U.S. oil lease after oil lease](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=63b0a9a2d8&e=6dcd2506d1) with no intention to allow future drilling.

These guys are so in the pocket of special interests and radical green environmentalists that they’re remorselessly sinking the U.S. economy. [I’m working in the AG’s office right now to break up the leftest green-energy cabal](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=220353956a&e=6dcd2506d1) that is stifling our energy independence and jacking up gas prices. But we need solutions in Washington too. As Arizona’s next Senator, I will introduce legislation that permanently cuts the gas tax, forces the administration to grant new oil leases, and allows for more-affordable gas blends.

The newest numbers from May show that we’ve hit a 40-year [record-high inflation rate at 8.6%](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=5cb50a23b0&e=6dcd2506d1). It’s getting so bad that [the Biden administration is looking to China](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=d2db0de08a&e=6dcd2506d1)—not American manufacturers—for help. We’ve been let down in a tremendous way and the Left is making deals with the devil instead of admitting their mistake and unleashing the American people and our businesses. It’s criminal. When I am in Washington, I’m slashing regulations, cutting taxes, and empowering the American people to rebuild America on their own terms. The government has done enough damage for one lifetime.
---

| Mark Brnovich

name: Ron DeSantis
subject: A new enemy has emerged
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWXs-e6hGN

Our country is currently facing a great threat. A new enemy has

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWXs-e6hGN

Friend,

Our
country is currently facing a great threat. A new enemy has
emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate
their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I
would hardly recognize.

This
enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll
anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the
American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling
dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted
version of history.

A group
that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -
perhaps in an even more sinister way - tear down the American
spirit itself. They go after the family unit, parental rights,
traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.

Over the
past few years, we've watched horrified as this group has
attempted to brainwash our children into thinking we live in an
evil, racist, irredeemable country.

We
listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater
all the while trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the
Constitution.

We saw
them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws
burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being
told they were "mostly peaceful" and "passionate."

We
watched Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of
truth - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through
the digital public square.

We
listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news
stories that didn't align with their preferred narrative, only to
watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically
expedient time.

Well,
Friend, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines
is over.

This
enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate
boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional
institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched.
But all hope is not lost.

We The
People still have a say. We know the truth, you and I, about
America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to
defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.

I am
choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with
freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen
to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it
down.

Together
we can ensure that our children are raised to know they live in
the greatest state in the nation, the greatest country in the
world, and that they have an opportunity to continue making them
even greater.

If you've
been waiting for the right time to get off the sidelines and
fight for the rights you know were given to man by God Himself -
the time is NOW.

If you're
with me, Friend, chip in any amount to help me defeat this
enemy. I can't do it without you. I promise you; I will never
stop fighting.

Sincerely,
Ron
DeSantis

CHIP IN
NOW

Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:

TIM BAXTER CALLS ON CONGRESS TO CANCEL AUGUST RECESS TO ADDRESS RECORD-HIGH INFLATION **New Hampshire (June 13, 2022)** \- During an interview with WMUR, Congressman Chris Pappas agreed that there should be "no days off for Congress" until the soaring rates of inflation are addressed. Today, Congressional candidate Tim Baxter released the following statement calling on Congress to cancel their August recess to address record-high inflation and prices at the gas pumps. _"The people of New Hampshire and all across the country are struggling to make ends meet and working two or more jobs just to feed their families. We cannot afford to let our 'leaders' in Washington take any days off until we address prices at the pumps and skyrocketing inflation. _ _That's why I am asking Chris Pappas to join me in demanding that Congress cancels its recess scheduled for August and utilize the time to come up with real solutions that will ease the financial burdens being forced on the American people. _ _I know members of Congress use their vacations to campaign, but can we really afford another month of no solutions when our economy is crashing beyond the point of no return?_ _Through reckless spending, printing trillions of dollars in the name of the 'greater good,' and ending America's energy independence on Joe Biden's first day, our elected officials created this mess, and they should use their scheduled time off to come up with real solutions." _ _###_ All media inquiries should be submitted to:
[press@BaxterForCongress.com](mailto:press@BaxterForCongress.com)

Today, Congressional candidate Tim Baxter released the following statement calling on Congress to cancel their August recess to address record-high inflation and prices at the gas pumps. I know members of Congress use their vacations to campaign, but can we really afford another month of no solutions when our economy is crashing beyond the point of no return? To view the most up to date CDC COVID-19 safety recommendations, And if you have a moment, please read our message below. I just need a minute of your time. Every day in America, 110 people lose their lives to gun violence and more than 200 are shot and wounded.1 But the far-right continues to allow the NRA and pro-gun lobbyists to stand in the way of common-sense gun reform that will save lives. As one of just three Democratic physicians serving in Congress, I know that in order to fight back against the gun lobby, we must call gun violence what it is: a public health crisis. I’m determined to fight for common-sense gun reform that will save lives and make our communities safer. But votes are still being tallied from last week's primary and far-right Republicans are seeking to unseat me and ruin our progress. | | | | From Buffalo, NY to Laguna Woods, CA to Uvalde, TX, communities across our nation are torn apart by the trauma of gun violence on a daily basis. Even more devastatingly, we have every resource necessary to combat this public health emergency. But the NRA’s hold on Congress continues to hinder progress toward common-sense gun reform -- and every day we delay, more lives are lost. But I am a firm believer that it doesn’t have to be this way. Democrats are working harder than ever to pass laws that address gun violence as the true public health crisis it is. We CAN make our communities safer and save lives – but only if we prevent NRA-backed Republicans from becoming the majority. | | | | | | Thank you for investing in this fight, \-- Dr. Raul Ruiz for Congress 1\. | | Hello Peter, it's Michelle Siri, John's running mate. In case you missed it, I wanted to proudly share that Pro-Choice Maryland Action recently endorsed our campaign for Governor and Lt. Governor! Having dedicated my career to the fight for reproductive rights – from my time as Board President of Planned Parenthood Maryland to my current role as Executive Director of the Women’s Law Center of Maryland – this endorsement from one of Maryland's leading reproductive rights organizations means the world to me. Especially now, as we wait for the conservative-majority Supreme Court to release their decision effectively reversing Roe, I recognize that the fight to protect women's right to choose and the right to bodily autonomy demands action now. So, as countless Marylanders and folks across the country ask "what's next?" in a post-Roe era, **I wanted to take a moment to invite you to join me, Heather Mizeur, Michele Gregory, and John tomorrow for a virtual conversation about the actions the next Maryland Democratic administration must take to not only protect abortion access in light of the potential SCOTUS decision to overturn Roe and Casey, but to make that access meaningful for everyone**.
---
**Date:** Tuesday, June 14th**Time:** 7:00-7:45PM **Where:** Virtual on Zoom**Featuring:** Democratic Candidate for MD-01 Heather Mizeur &
Democratic Candidate for Senate District 38 Michele Gregory

---
[**RSVP**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46481329/350443307/953548707?utm_source=ngp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=events&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNzEzNmEwNi02MGViLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c8Cf9RojdvVq2XJidjlZJDYb6pEoeluh9HMWWgwrfE0=&emci=9ee7f9a3-59c6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=07136a06-60eb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)
---
| | If you care about access to safe, legal abortion, now is the time to learn how to mobilize and fight for women’s rights to govern their own bodies. No matter who you are or where you come from, each of us deserves the dignity to make choices for ourselves.
Unfortunately, we cannot depend on the federal government to protect these rights, we need to push Maryland to lead by an example for the rest of the country on how to support reproductive freedom. Maryland is poised to become one of the most southern states where abortion will remain completely legal and protected by law, and a King-Siri administration will lead the charge to support our neighbors seeking reproductive health care when their own states won’t provide it.
So I hope you'll join John, Heather, Michele and me for a powerful conversation moderated by Lily Bolourian, Executive Director for Pro-Choice Maryland Action to discuss what can be done at the state and federal levels to protect abortion access. **Tune in here:** **[www.mobilize.us/teamjohnkingforgovernor/event/469544/](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46481330/350443309/953548707?utm_source=ngp&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=events&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNzEzNmEwNi02MGViLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=c8Cf9RojdvVq2XJidjlZJDYb6pEoeluh9HMWWgwrfE0=&emci=9ee7f9a3-59c6-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=07136a06-60eb-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=24635484)** Now more than ever, we need leadership that understands what’s at stake and what it really means to support reproductive freedom. Without the basic dignity of bodily autonomy, we can never achieve gender equality. Thank you and I hope to see you there, Michelle Siri

clean_body: Tomorrow at 7PM, join Heather Mizeur, Michele Gregory, John King and me for a virtual conversation about what comes next in the fight for abortion access in a post-Roe era| | | | | Hello Peter, it's Michelle Siri, John's running mate. In case you missed it, I wanted to proudly share that Pro-Choice Maryland Action recently endorsed our campaign for Governor and Lt. Governor! Having dedicated my career to the fight for reproductive rights – from my time as Board President of Planned Parenthood Maryland to my current role as Executive Director of the Women’s Law Center of Maryland – this endorsement from one of Maryland's leading reproductive rights organizations means the world to me. Especially now, as we wait for the conservative-majority Supreme Court to release their decision effectively reversing Roe, I recognize that the fight to protect women's right to choose and the right to bodily autonomy demands action now. So, as countless Marylanders and folks across the country ask "what's next?" in a post-Roe era, I wanted to take a moment to invite you to join me, Heather Mizeur, Michele Gregory, and John tomorrow for a virtual conversation about the actions the next Maryland Democratic administration must take to not only protect abortion access in light of the potential SCOTUS decision to overturn Roe and Casey, but to make that access meaningful for everyone. Date: Tuesday, June 14thTime: 7:00-7:45PM Where: Virtual on ZoomFeaturing: Democratic Candidate for MD-01 Heather Mizeur & Democratic Candidate for Senate District 38 Michele Gregory | | If you care about access to safe, legal abortion, now is the time to learn how to mobilize and fight for women’s rights to govern their own bodies. No matter who you are or where you come from, each of us deserves the dignity to make choices for ourselves. Unfortunately, we cannot depend on the federal government to protect these rights, we need to push Maryland to lead by an example for the rest of the country on how to support reproductive freedom. Maryland is poised to become one of the most southern states where abortion will remain completely legal and protected by law, and a King-Siri administration will lead the charge to support our neighbors seeking reproductive health care when their own states won’t provide it. So I hope you'll join John, Heather, Michele and me for a powerful conversation moderated by Lily Bolourian, Executive Director for Pro-Choice Maryland Action to discuss what can be done at the state and federal levels to protect abortion access. Tune in here: Now more than ever, we need leadership that understands what’s at stake and what it really means to support reproductive freedom. Without the basic dignity of bodily autonomy, we can never achieve gender equality. Anyone who has followed our campaign knows I am prepared to give my life fighting against this exact oppression. But let me back up. My name is Ryan Kelley. You've probably never heard of me, or at least hadn't heard of me before today when my name and picture was splashed across every news outlet in the country. Thats ok. The media and the establishment swamp have tried to pretend I don't exist, but I am now leading in the polls to be the Republican nominee for Governor in Michigan. **That's right. Governor. In Michigan. A state where election fraud happened and Trump's victory was stolen...and Biden's DOJ just had me arrested. ** I started this campaign for a simple reason. The government's grip on the throat of its citizenry has grown so tight as to make our republic unrecognizable. When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up.
