FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE June 13th, 2022
**Vega Releases New Ad Highlighting Biden’s Failures at Southern Border, Consequences of Unchecked Illegal Immigration**
**PRINCE WILLIAM COUNTY –** Today, Yesli Vega, Republican candidate for Virginia’s 7th Congressional District, released her new ad sharing the moment she found out her brother and his friend had been shot by MS-13 gang members and how that moment drove her to pursue a career in law enforcement. The ad also highlights Biden and the Democrat’s failures at the Southern border and how those failures are impacting communities across the country.
[](http://links.yeslivegaforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=876a4969a9724ab8bc814d84bfee8268&_m=aac0534c4a1247dabd14243d9fa48209&_e=qOiWJY9bK1O0o9feGZ3t4xTw_C6ckPoHS-H3MVKLCMrkEPbM4tUv2yiTV21VEYWWBqBu9h6E3_e46I52u10AriqbVJlJlLAqJhDThPdrZ_3dmHtUJx9_s8FLJAVQEXhDcDzwHhskyGcx19XCZExJdg8epJgwNrA1U9W5oI1kin6ZYuWw_0zPcIqzkwsgsqXvx23H-nkZ1mvjA0xUwOjQ60FWbhHZI44rxY0fTfKtPMNufOiMdDHQvBEIIpuQlks0PqNuM3wk0vwBt-0_mF48nzOWjWelmd8R1dCNRT6XEVk%3D) You can watch the full ad **[HERE.](http://links.yeslivegaforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=876a4969a9724ab8bc814d84bfee8268&_m=aac0534c4a1247dabd14243d9fa48209&_e=qOiWJY9bK1O0o9feGZ3t4xTw_C6ckPoHS-H3MVKLCMrkEPbM4tUv2yiTV21VEYWWBqBu9h6E3_e46I52u10Arhf9mdIeeiCMVOjZvQKE7YHY-gU5yNcw189_p8Kx-McWwA-bcauMBxysDQj2I1UpfcRQfRH6aEopUu05XAaEiq1T743A1czI_16lpelUle4JKbcxJMiYSh6cPBcQkaEpIP8prYb_Trp5k1kPqFQglUmfGL5Ym0h3XrJR28Rjhu5VNtQDxcWwIXA551Gew4fJdc_RVzO-_ikpa-X59msP26w%3D)**
“The humanitarian crisis at our Southern border is out of control. Illegal drugs and criminals come across daily, spilling into our communities, disrupting our lives, and destroying our families. I’ve experienced this firsthand when my younger brother and his friend were gunned down by MS-13 gang members while on their way to a movie. By the grace of God my brother survived, his friend died that night. That moment propelled me into my law enforcement career because I wanted to do everything I could to protect my community from this evil. Our new ad is the product of my story and the passion I have for securing our Southern border, keeping drugs and criminals off our streets, and ensuring our communities and families are safe.” **– Yesli Vega, Candidate for Virginia’s 7th District**

**Background:**

Yesli and her family were leaving church when they received the phone call that her younger brother and his friend had been gunned down at random while waiting for their friend before heading to the movie theatre. Yesli’s younger brother survived the shooting, but sadly their family friend died that night.

It was later revealed that the shooters were taking part in an MS-13 gang initiation process, where the quickest way for new initiates to work their way up the hierarchy is to murder someone.

The professionalism and care with which the local law enforcement agencies dealt with the situation inspired Yesli to want to give back and help protect her community from these kinds of senseless acts of violence.

Yesli’s career began as a street cop with the City of Alexandria’s Police Department where she faced the split second, life or death situations our men and women in blue face every day they put on the uniform. Yesli temporarily left the world of law enforcement to join her husband in South Korea on his military deployment. Upon returning, Yesli went back into law enforcement with the Manassas Park Police Department where she became a certified hostage negotiator, and later joined the Prince William County Sheriff’s Office to serve as a deputy and Crisis Intervention Team member.

Vega still serves as an Auxiliary Deputy Sheriff for the Prince William County Sheriff’s Department.

We have the grassroots advantage, but we can’t suffer a blowout on the money side.
#
We'll get right to it.
Our next Texas Ethics Commission (TEC) financial reporting deadline is coming up on June 30th, and we simply can't afford to be outraised by Greg Abbott again — not with less than five months until Election Day.
Here’s a reminder of how fundraising has gone so far:
**TEC Deadline** | **Who reported more money raised, Beto or Abbott?**
---|---
December 31st, 2021 | **Greg Abbott**
January 20th | **Greg Abbott**
February 19th | **Greg Abbott**
Thanks to his corporate mega-donors, Greg Abbott has outraised us in every filing period since Beto joined the race. But the good news is that we've shown that _we have far more grassroots support than Greg Abbott._
**Wednesday is the mid-month mark before our next TEC deadline, and it’s vital we show Texans that we have what it takes to finally match Abbott’s resources.** That's why we’re reaching out today to see if you can help pick up the pace and ensure we outraise Abbott this time around.
**[We've set a goal to raise $254,000 — $1,000 for every Texas county — by Wednesday at midnight, and falling short is not an option. Please, pitch in your first $3 contribution right now.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220613-1.ogOQrc&refcode=ema20220613-193769&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=193769%2E444211%2EMa-muo)**

Your donation before Wednesday’s deadline is a critical investment in the campaign we're building to take on Abbott. Every dollar will go towards the infrastructure we need to run the largest grassroots campaign Texas has ever seen. And it will show that we can win without a cent from corporate PACs.
We're already making history. We have over 70,000 volunteers — writing letters, calling voters, and talking to Texans at their door. Beto is drawing big crowds to his campaign stops. And CNN just declared our campaign a top race to watch in 2022.
But, if we're going to reach our goals and win this election, we can't suffer a blowout on the money side.

I really need your help to get my campaign in order I stopped a terrortist attack on a train to Paris, now I'm ready to serve the great state of Oregon in Congress. | Memo : We need your immediate help to keep pace with my opponent and national democrats » Peter, The purpose of this email to inform you of the overall fundraising goal that we’ve set for the month of June. Reaching this fundraising milestone will allow me to remain in the National Republican Party’s “Young Gun” program for promising candidates. Last quarter my Democrat opponent raised nearly as much as we did - and that’s saying something since she just became the Dem nominee last month. That has my team on edge. My opponent knows what my team is capable of; she knows my team and I are focused and adept fundraisers, and she’s preparing early for what’s expected to be among the closest races in the nation this fall. We need to make sure that we do our part to add to the overall Republican donor total in Q2 (June 30th deadline). Thank you for your support and consideration. Hello,
Growing up in rural Iowa, I thought we were well-to-do because we had a piano, a well-used sewing machine, a big garden, and a flag pole. Our house was small, one bathroom, for a family of ten. I was surprised to know that not every family struggled with affording the $7 meal ticket each kid needed for school.
Lebanon, Iowa, had eight houses, a church, and a small feed store. My life centered on helping my dad, school, and exploring Dry Creek, a wonderland of aquatic life down the hill. The nearest town was Hudson, SD, nine miles west down a gravel road.
We were the prototypical rural Iowa family. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, lunch, then supper kept the house full of aromas. “Read a book,” would be mom’s terse direction if you showed any idleness. It is from this humble beginning, work as a welder, farmhand, then in a slaughterhouse, that brought me into the U.S. Navy.
America must present an opportunity for its citizens to achieve great things. From homemade clothes (I’m the littlest one) to a three-star Admiral is just one such journey. The next step is to use life’s experiences to continue a lifetime of service to this nation and my state of Iowa.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa because I can represent people from all walks of life. My life’s experiences provided an innate understanding for what it means to be a Democrat:_to care as much for those I’ve never met as I do for those I know_. Obviously, Chuck Grassley is not a Democrat; he seems to only care about what Trump and his corporate PAC donors want.**
People like me aren’t supposed to be able to run and win. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are already raising millions from corporate special interests to try to make sure I don’t.
If there’s one thing I’ve learned in life, though, it’s that anything is possible when a group of people work together to make it happen. I’m not taking one dime from corporate PACs; instead, I’m running my campaign entirely with support from over 71,000 grassroots donors like you.
[**So please, if you’re able to, will you consider making a donation to my campaign today to help me defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue? clean_body: Hello, Growing up in rural Iowa, I thought we were well-to-do because we had a piano, a well-used sewing machine, a big garden, and a flag pole. Our house was small, one bathroom, for a family of ten. I was surprised to know that not every family struggled with affording the $7 meal ticket each kid needed for school. Lebanon, Iowa, had eight houses, a church, and a small feed store. My life centered on helping my dad, school, and exploring Dry Creek, a wonderland of aquatic life down the hill. The nearest town was Hudson, SD, nine miles west down a gravel road. We were the prototypical rural Iowa family. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, lunch, then supper kept the house full of aromas. “Read a book,” would be mom’s terse direction if you showed any idleness. It is from this humble beginning, work as a welder, farmhand, then in a slaughterhouse, that brought me into the U.S. Navy. America must present an opportunity for its citizens to achieve great things. From homemade clothes (I’m the littlest one) to a three-star Admiral is just one such journey. The next step is to use life’s experiences to continue a lifetime of service to this nation and my state of Iowa. I’m running for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa because I can represent people from all walks of life. My life’s experiences provided an innate understanding for what it means to be a Democrat:to care as much for those I’ve never met as I do for those I know. Obviously, Chuck Grassley is not a Democrat; he seems to only care about what Trump and his corporate PAC donors want. People like me aren’t supposed to be able to run and win. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are already raising millions from corporate special interests to try to make sure I don’t. If there’s one thing I’ve learned in life, though, it’s that anything is possible when a group of people work together to make it happen. We can't let this cycle continue | | | Hi Peter, First of all, I just wanted to check in on you. I know I've been out for a few months, but I'm even more invigorated than ever to put everything I have behind Democrats as we approach this critical midterm election cycle. **One of the most rewarding – and also difficult – parts of my job is driving across the country to speak with people just like you._[Chip in $15 or more to support my organization's mission to help rural Democrats →](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xNG6r6b6yi4Uz9vCRXD2GcbjNJ8kV0XSCfadu0BIOFpsgqZ_7P2QjQ7zOUCUQ8mZay1yg-qh1Bv8u31q-tp49EY9sAKeiwxz60ktp4ZxEECW-AuqslneVIsKK93CbUmf_L5TFG6bkrdiUqDqIyH6n93OQSx-7PRypwNLA0-5uD7678Csrt_6B1gdCiNgnLWbeNCizKSEj97ntj3uwsboEm4qD66oy6OwpjIDmj2okGElOl7HilJP_rCyKBUfuD-_FoJdbnfXGiIWCsNCHnaCC7Pb0GEFHVk-nPU0jtfYMLeZYRpdz_fVwsQMF_Dme6aHR1k99Sx1L3BM46foU9RVAmeRWKtR4WP7i7G0H0u9buE2I3ojFg9NUKDD4rOQw8E6OQaz57JudUR9zgV8UbentGANcM4jKp4884XjDn-0embgzFoIZVkFezZFpNJoeksuI/3mv/N9wza_RxSLKPREOLwlIguQ/h0/xrclXgrqCn4Y3vwDR7W5umPNjZ0ymMG5C3NIQTUqQE8)_** I've driven over 100,000 miles, across small towns and rural communities, to listen to people's struggles and hear how URD can help. **On my drives, I've heard an overwhelming sentiment – people in rural America feel left behind.** They're not alone. I grew up in Indiana and Illinois and have always had deep roots in my Midwestern community. Going to Iowa State, you get the sense that not that many students are really interested in politics, or think that their representatives can actually help them. I was fortunate enough to work for some amazing Democratic candidates who proved them wrong, but the fact of the matter is that Democrats haven't been paying enough attention to rural America for some time now. **After founding United Rural Democrats, we set out to change that.** No one in this country should feel left behind. We know Democratic principles and policies are the best way to help rural communities, but we also know that a Democratic win requires organizing, commitment, and constant work. It's our job to get Democrats involved and prove to people in communities just like mine that the future of this country needs Democratic leadership. **[Will you help me and my organization make sure clean_body: We can't let this cycle continue | | | Hi Peter, First of all, I just wanted to check in on you. I know I've been out for a few months, but I'm even more invigorated than ever to put everything I have behind Democrats as we approach this critical midterm election cycle. One of the most rewarding – and also difficult – parts of my job is driving across the country to speak with people just like you. I've driven over 100,000 miles, across small towns and rural communities, to listen to people's struggles and hear how URD can help. On my drives, I've heard an overwhelming sentiment – people in rural America feel left behind. They're not alone. I grew up in Indiana and Illinois and have always had deep roots in my Midwestern community. Going to Iowa State, you get the sense that not that many students are really interested in politics, or think that their representatives can actually help them. I was fortunate enough to work for some amazing Democratic candidates who proved them wrong, but the fact of the matter is that Democrats haven't been paying enough attention to rural America for some time now. After founding United Rural Democrats, we set out to change that. No one in this country should feel left behind. We know Democratic principles and policies are the best way to help rural communities, but we also know that a Democratic win requires organizing, commitment, and constant work. It's our job to get Democrats involved and prove to people in communities just like mine that the future of this country needs Democratic leadership. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: Thank you for taking the time to listen to my story, Peter. – Joe Shephard, Founder and President of United Rural Democrats United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. This is despicable, friend:

For nearly 50 years, _Roe v. Wade_ has protected the constitutional right to make extremely personal decisions about our bodies, our health care, and our own family. But now, the Supreme Court's ultraconservative justices are planning to take that fundamental right away.
This decision would overturn _decades_ of legal precedent. It goes against the will of the overwhelming majority of the American people. **And it directly threatens the health and lives of millions across our country.**
I refuse to stand by and let anti-choice politicians roll back the clock on reproductive freedom. I promise you that I will do everything I possibly can to protect bodily autonomy and guarantee abortion rights under federal law, but it's not a fight I can win alone: I need _you_ with me.
**That's why I'm looking for 15,000 people to speak out alongside me before midnight tonight – and I'm counting on you to be one of them, friend. Please, tell me right now:**

Insider News from the Political Revolution!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

HEADLINES: Bust Big Tech! | Bar J6 Criminals from the Ballot | Bernie’s
Warning for Dems | Big Election Wins in CA - Iowa - TX! | Vote Amy Vilela
on Tuesday! | Phonebank for Progressives | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5972?c0=OR_EM_NEWS_90DO_20220613_1_2.OI8ot8&t=1011&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]We’re battling corporate authoritarianism at every turn: taking on Big
Tech, challenging Insurrectionists, and electing allies to replace
corporate Dems in the 2022 primaries. Become a RECURRING DONOR to Our
Revolution right now to help shift power to the people!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1012&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1013&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

TAKING ACTION AGAINST J6 INSURRECTIONISTS!

Thursday kicked off the January 6th Committee hearings - but the truth is
- while Congress has the power to investigate and expose, it has no power
to prosecute.

That’s why Our Revolution members are hitting the streets to demand that
Secretaries of State enforce the Constitution and bar criminal
insurrectionists from the ballot.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5958?t=1014&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]Fox 43 reported on our demonstration in Harrisburg on Wednesday,
calling on PA Secretary of State Leigh Chapman to bar US Rep. Scott Perry
and GOP gubernatorial candidate Doug Mastriano from the November ballot.

On Thursday, we rallied outside Andy Biggs office in Mesa, AZ, calling AZ
Sec. of State Katie Hobbs to bar him and his fellow Rep. Paul Gosar - as
well as Trump - from the ballot.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5959?t=1015&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]Lima Ohio News reported on our action outside the office of Sec. of
State Franklin LaRose, demanding US Rep. Jim Jordan’s disqualification.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1016&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

In Grand Junction, CO on Friday, we called on Secretary of State Jena
Griswold to act on the constitutional mandate that US Rep. Lauren Boebert,
too, is ineligible for re-election.

This week, Our Revolution leaders also started sending official letters to
51 state election officials requesting meetings with our legal team with
Free Speech for People to discuss how they can enforce the law of the land
and protect democracy, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5960?t=1017&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]Truthout reported.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1018&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

It’s no secret that Trump is plotting his return to power, so there’s no
time to waste. If you want to volunteer for our campaign and hold January
6th criminals accountable, please [ mailto:defenddemocracy@ourrevolution.com ]email us!

Be sure to add your name as a citizen advocate that our laws be enforced
and insurrectionist criminals be kept out of government.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5961?t=1019&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]SIGN THE PETITION

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1020&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1021&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

BUST BIG TECH

MAJOR BILLS TO TAKE ON TECH’S MONOPOLY POWER!

A small number of companies have way too much power, and it’s crippling
our democracy.

Join Our Revolution and our allies in a strategic national campaign to
bust up the power of the big tech monopolies acting as gatekeepers to the
public square.

The Open Apps Markets Act and the American Innovation and Choice Act have
a REAL SHOT TO PASS and would enable fair competition on Big Tech
platforms and app markets. This will create fairness for small businesses
and empower users with more choice on the platforms.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer has pledged a floor vote this month —
and we’re going to hold him to it!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5728?t=1022&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]You can take a quick and simple action to kick off this fight! CALL
YOUR SENATORS NOW and tell them you want these two important bills passed!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1023&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

On Monday we were joined by US Rep. David Cicilline (RI-1), who has led
the fight to Bust Big Tech as chair of the House Antitrust Subcommittee.

“There’s a lot of momentum behind these bills,” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5962?t=1024&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]Bloomberg reported him
saying on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5963?t=1025&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]live broadcast. “They have significant bipartisan
support, and they will pass when they come to the chambers in the coming
weeks.”

“Concentrated economic power comes with concentrated political power,”
Rep. Cicilline told us. “By spending millions on ads and lobbying to try
to defeat these bills, Big Tech is making our point of how dangerous
monopoly power is to our democracy and economy.”

Apple, Amazon, Google and Meta spent $16.7 million lobbying in the first
three months of this year, identifying the antitrust bills as their top
priority. Tech-backed trade groups spent another $25M in ads.

“If you look at the history of our country, it's been the battle between
democracy and concentrated economic power,” Rep. Cicilline said. “This is
the most recent form of it, and we can win this fight.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5728?t=1026&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]CALL YOUR SENATORS

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1027&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

Barry Lynn, executive director of the Open Markets Institute, who
pioneered understanding of how 21st Century monopolies, talked about his
decades of work on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5963?t=1028&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]live broadcast Monday.

“For every ill we face today, monopolists are part of the cause — driving
down our wages, driving up inflation and rent, causing shortages like baby
formula, taking away our healthcare, undermining national security,
fueling the climate crisis,” Barry said.

“We must use our most powerful political tool - our anti-monopoly laws.
That’s how we build Liberty, Democracy, Community, Peace, Prosperity,” he
stated.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5728?t=1029&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]CALL YOUR SENATORS

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1030&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

Fight for our Future Director Evan Greer revved up the folks on our
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5963?t=1031&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]national organizing call, emphasizing the huge opportunity we have to
pass real antitrust legislation.

“Big Tech lobbyists are throwing everything they have because they’re
panicking,” Evan said. “They see the writing on the wall — no member of
Congress wants to go on the record as a shill for Big Tech, and they know
when these bills hit the floor, they’re going to pass overwhelmingly.”

“We can strike at the heart of these companies’ harm - which is their
scale and power that gives them outsized influence over our economy and
what the future of our society looks like,” Evan said. “I wake up every
day with cynicism, critical of our political systems, but then we have to
be stoked and seize these opportunities to make something happen.”

We’re asking everyone to make a quick call to your senators right now and
ask them to support two major antitrust bills to curb the monopoly power
of Big Tech.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5728?t=1032&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]When you follow this link, you’ll put in info and instantly get an
automatic call connecting you with your senators offices. Most times,
you’ll just leave a brief message - so it’s not no work at all!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1033&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

DEMS SERIOUSLY MUST DELIVER

Learning nothing, Corporate Dems have spent the Biden administration
giving excuse after excuse about why they haven’t kept their promises or
delivered for working people.

Bernie, as usual, put it best: “You really can’t win an election with a
bumper sticker that says: ‘Well, we can’t do much, but the other side is
worse.’”

Young, Hispanic, Asian-American and Black voters are all drifting away
from Democrats, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5964?t=1034&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]Politico said, noting Bernie’s warning: “Unless we
turn around, the voter turnout is going to be very, very low on the
Democratic base.”

With the Republican Party openly embracing fascism, we can’t afford
another second of this pathetic weakness.

That’s why [ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5973?t=1035&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]Our Revolution is working every day to defeat corporate
Dems in primaries and elect progressives who will actually fight to make
our democracy function and deliver for the lives of working people.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1036&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1037&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

While the mainstream media claims voters are rejecting criminal justice
reform in big cities, they’re missing the real story unfolding in front of
their eyes.

In major population centers like Alameda County, CA, progressive civil
rights attorney Pamela Price is poised to win the District Attorney’s
race! And in Contra Costa County, CA, progressive DA Diane Becton won her
re-election bid!

Progressives fared well in other CA races, too - Alex Lee ran a
corporate-free campaign that overcame attacks from real estate developers
to win his primary for re-election to the CA Assembly D-25. And, Fatima
Iqbal-Zubair - backed by Bernie! - will also move on to the General
Election in November for Assembly District 65.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1038&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

Congratulations to Our Revolution Iowa victorious candidates in the June
7th primary!

Deidre DeJear made history on Tuesday by becoming the state’s first Black
nominee for Governor from a major party. And, Kimberly Graham heads to
November as the likely next Polk County Attorney, another progressive
prosecutor winning on issues like wage theft and sentencing disparities –
not prosecuting low-level marijuana offenses.

State Rep. Liz Bennett is on track to be the first out-LGBTQ woman in the
State Senate! Molly Donahue also won her Senate primary on a message of
restoring collective bargaining rights to public-sector unions!

Dr. Megan Srinivas led her primary for State House as a powerful voice for
public health throughout the pandemic. She pledges to repeal Medicaid
privatization and fight for a living wage.

Our Revolution also snagged two progressive County Supervisor seats with
Jon Green, who wants to bring Bernie’s vision to Johnson County, home to
Iowa City, and Tavis Hall who won on a message of economic and criminal
justice in Black Hawk County.

[ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=1039&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]Our fight is far from finished! This month, we have working-class
fighters on the ballot in Illinois, Nevada, New York, and around the
country. Chip-in now to keep chipping away at the corporate establishment.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1040&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

ELECTION DAY FOR AMY IN NEVADA

Amy Vilela heads to Election Day on Tuesday in Nevada’s 1st District
backed by Bernie Sanders and Our Revolution. Sending Amy to Congress would
be HUGE for our movement!!

One of our most passionate champions for Medicare for All, Amy served as
Nevada Co-Chair for Bernie Sanders’ 2020 campaign, and now she’s taking on
a corporate-backed Democratic incumbent for this pivotal Vegas seat.

“I am running to represent the working class,” Amy told us on a
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5453?t=1041&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]National Organizing Call. “This is the right race at the right time,
and stakeholders on the frontlines want a seat at the table.”

Let’s get out the vote in NV-1 — find a Vote Center [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5966?t=1042&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ]HERE!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5957?t=1043&akid=3032%2E5885482%2E8Ucs25 ][IMG]

EARLY VOTING STARTS IN D.C.

Early voting is also underway in Washington, D.C., where Our Revolution is
backing Erin Palmer and Zachary Parker to make the DC Council more
progressive!

Erin is running for DC Council Chairwoman against a corporate-funded
incumbent backed by gambling bosses and big developers. Like Erin, Zach is

clean_body: | | | | Peter Willis, In two days, we’ll be facing our mid-month deadline for June. Before I ask , let me explain why it’s so important that we reach our goal. This deadline marks just about 60 days out from the August primary. While my opponents in this race are willing to take bribes from corporate PACs and special interest groups, I’m running a shoestring campaign that depends entirely on grassroots support and the generosity of our volunteers. With two months left to go until the August primary, we need a groundswell of donations from people like you to keep this campaign going. Before I ever thought of running for Congress, I was an organizer with multiple community groups working to protect reproductive rights, achieve economic justice, end family separation at the border, and protect low-income tenants from eviction. I know we have the support of working people here in NY-03, because I’ve been out organizing in these communities for years. And I know the power of Big Organizing, because I’ve seen repeatedly how a committed coalition of people like you can WIN against all odds. The politicians taking Big Money from corporate PACs can't be trusted to help working families or protect marginalized communities. Only a true grassroots movement will elect the kind of unbought and uncompromising representation for working people that we need in Congress. With our next FEC end-of-quarter deadline approaching, and the primary getting closer every day, we need to ensure we’re staying on track and raising the grassroots dollars needed to keep moving forward. Thanks, Peter Willis. — Melanie Melanie D'Arrigo is a mother of three and healthcare advocate running for New York's 3rd District on Medicare for All and the Green New Deal. ## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter — Nancy
Pelosi started campaigning against Justice Democrat Kina Collins LAST
year, more than 9 months before Kina’s primary against corporate Democrat
Danny Davis. Here’s Pelosi on the campaign trail for Davis in September:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110450?refcode=em20220613-23829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=23829%2E1203867%2EaTKHFj ]Nancy Pelosi speaking at a podium at an event for Danny Davis

But Pelosi has been campaigning against us for even longer than that. Here
she is campaigning for anti-abortion, pro-NRA Democrat Henry Cuellar back
in 2020.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110450?refcode=em20220613-23829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23829%2E1203867%2EaTKHFj ]Nancy Pelosi at a campaign event for Henry Cuellar in 2020. Cuellar
stands behind Pelosi giving a thumbs up

Pelosi has gone all-in against us in 2022. She’s donated to our opponents
and campaigned for anti-abortion Cueller (again) and corporate-backed
Davis. It’s clear: the Democratic establishment is afraid of what will
happen if we expand the Squad and add more progressive fighters alongside
AOC, Rashida Tlaib, and Cori Bush.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110450?refcode=em20220613-23829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23829%2E1203867%2EaTKHFj ]Can you help us fight back with a donation to Kina and Justice
Democrats today? Kina has just two weeks to combat massive corporate
spending against her — we can only win this race with your support.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110450?refcode=em20220613-23829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=23829%2E1203867%2EaTKHFj ]Contribute

Pelosi is supporting Davis and spending time campaigning for him instead
of focusing on protecting the Democratic majority in the House for the
same reason she supported Cuellar in 2020 and 2022. Even though Cuellar
obstructed the Democratic agenda, Pelosi’s priority is to defeat Justice
Democrats.

More than passing transformative legislation, more than keeping control of
Congress away from right-wing extremists, Pelosi cares #1 about protecting
her corporate donors and the status quo.

Kina Collins is running to be a representative of the people — and unlike
Congressman Davis, she won’t fight for the interests of health insurance
companies, the real estate industry, and big corporations. We knew that
Kina would be heavily outspent, but we didn’t expect Nancy Pelosi to jump
in last September, so early on in the race, to chase down big donations
for Davis.

Nancy Pelosi is campaigning and raising money for Davis, because she knows
that Kina Collins is a formidable primary opponent. But we can’t raise the
type of mega donor dollars that Pelosi can.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110450?refcode=em20220613-23829&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=23829%2E1203867%2EaTKHFj ]Can you split a contribution to Justice Democrats and Kina Collins
right now, so we can defeat the establishment? Our chances of sending Kina
to Congress go way up if we can bring in a massive wave of grassroots
donations right now. Can you chip in? We only have 15 days left before
Kina’s primary.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=23829%2E1203867%2EaTKHFj ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1026&akid=23829%2E1203867%2EaTKHFj ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Fellow patriot,

The Trump-hating Democrats on the January 6th Committee want to **silence me**. They want to **embarrass me**.

They don’t want the truth ... what they really want is to stop Donald Trump from running for President again in 2024, and at the same time, they want to **end me, or at least weaken my voice in the House for years to come.**

But I’m going to keep talking straight with you. I can tell you without hesitation that Pelosi’s bogus committee (**a committee on which I was asked to serve by Republicans, only to be booted by Pelosi for purely partisan gain**) – serves no other purpose than to distract from the Democrats’ ABHORRENT handling of inflation, the economy, and our national security.

This Committee is not just misguided...it is dangerous because **Democrats don’t believe the law applies to them like it does the rest of us** , so they feel like they can completely abandon the Constitution, free speech, and the rule of law in this process.

name: Charles Booker
subject: Rand Paul’s alarming history.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Enough is enough,
Peter.

For too long, Rand Paul has used his power in office to help his white
supremacist friends and incite hate and division in our country.

* He single-handedly blocked the Emmett Till Anti-Lynching Act from
passing in 2020 which would have made this heinous act a federal hate
crime two years ago.
* He voted against the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and
denied basic voting protections for Black and brown communities.
* While families buried their loved ones following the massacre in
Buffalo in May, Rand Paul opposed the bill to address domestic
terrorism fueled by racism — saying racism has ‘gotten better’ since
the 1960s.
* He spread the lie that the 2020 election was stolen after a record
number of Black Georgians voted and helped incite a violent white
supremacist insurrection.

In this historic election, the choice couldn’t be clearer. Do we move
forward together, or do we let politicians like Rand Paul forever hold us
back and drive us apart?

In November, we will choose justice, healing, and humanity, and FINALLY
remove this dangerous man from the Senate.

I need your help to make this happen,
Peter. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220613.-Pq1AH&refcode=em20220613-other-2060&t=1001&akid=2060%2E346206%2EL_LxPd ]Will you chip in
$5 right now to show Rand Paul that this movement is rising
up to end his political career?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220613.-Pq1AH&refcode=em20220613-2060&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=2060%2E346206%2EL_LxPd ]Donate $5 now →

Let’s be clear, Rand Paul’s reactions to these painful events are all
connected, and they all have the same end goal: to maintain white
supremacy.

This year, we have a real chance to write a new chapter in our history;
one that moves us forward in the fight for economic, racial, and
environmental justice.

We have a chance to move our country forward towards a future where we
don’t have to worry about our door’s getting kicked in or our children
facing police violence because of the color of their skin.

We have a chance to send a young Black man from the hood and descendant of
enslaved Kentuckians to the United States Senate, replace Rand Paul, and
bring forth a new chapter of equitable, strong leadership to our
Commonwealth.

Rand Paul may want to divide us, but hate won’t win this time. I know
that, together, we can create the future we want — for ourselves, for our
loved ones, and for our communities.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220613.-Pq1AH&refcode=em20220613-other-2060&t=1021&akid=2060%2E346206%2EL_LxPd ]That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate and I hope you're ready to join
me in this fight. So I have to ask one more time: will you please chip in
$5 to our campaign?

It’s time to move forward together.

Thank you,

Charles

# From the desk of former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani

Dear Friend,

I'm concerned about the terrible situation we are in right now. America is at a point here in 2022 where we are going to decide if the great American experiment will succeed or fail.

You see, we are surrounded by politicians who don’t believe in the American ideal. Democrats in Illinois and Washington, D.C.—with Joe Biden as their incoherent, confused leader—are doing everything they can to destroy the constitutional fabric that has made this the greatest Republic in the history of the earth.

This is no exaggeration. We are really at the precipice of failure if we cannot turn things around: quickly! This is why I am urging you to support Scott Kaspar in the upcoming Illinois 6th Congressional District primary on June 28th.

(You can contribute to Scott's campaign [here](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=7f3b50719e&e=9931950ab1).)

I was recently in Illinois to support my friend Scott Kaspar. I have to tell you. Scott is one of the most able, capable men I’ve known. And I don’t say that lightly. Scott understands how desperate things have become. And he knows how to do what it takes in Washington to change things quickly.

Consider how bad things are here in Illinois and in Chicago and Cook County in particular. Crime is destroying families and businesses in your area. And it’s literally killing hundreds of people as well. It’s a desperate situation.

I faced a far worse problem when I was elected as Mayor of New York City in 1994. We were averaging 2200 murders per year when I took office. Violent crime and theft were out of control. But me and my administration rallied together, and we took action immediately after I took office.

We gave them the resources they needed. We didn’t hold back on that. We designed methods they could lawfully use to stop nuisance crimes which helped stem the tide of worse criminal behavior. We added cops on the street to help cover problem areas, and it worked. Violent crimes reduced by 65% and murder rates went down by 70%.

My friend and NYC Police Commissioner Bernard Kerik played a significant role in helping this change happen. We immediately took the shackles off our police officers. We gave them the freedom to do their jobs within the law and under the rules of the police department. We didn’t second guess them.
We told them to go do good and work hard to protect the people in New York City.

This was no accident. We worked hard and implemented smart ideas that stemmed the tide of crime. People began to come back to our city as tourists and for business. We thrived. It was an amazing turnaround. I didn’t do this alone. I had people like Bernie Kerik and so many others helping me.

I’ve seen the political cesspool from New York City to Washington, D.C. I spent the last few years helping my good friend President Donald Trump navigate one of the worst efforts to take down our political system I have ever witnessed. My experiences and the situations I’ve witnessed in that effort and in elected office myself will help explain why we need to send people to Washington who love America, love the values of America.

Washington isn’t restraining themselves in any way these days. They are attacking our freedoms and liberties and reshaping our very lives without our consent. We need people like Scott Kaspar to be elected to Congress because he dedicated to stopping this illegitimate process which is putting our very lives at risk.

We have a chance to save America. The chance begins on the 28th of June. The choices you make then and the choices you make in November can allow us to halt the damage being done to our great country because of Biden administration policies. Right now we are on an express train towards communism, Marxism, socialism. Our economy is a socialist economy. More people don’t pay taxes than pay taxes. The tax system is being rigged no longer to support the government but to redistribute wealth in the country.

But we take our cues from proven principles of freedom that made this the most free and prosperous nation in the history of the earth. We take our cues from the Constitution of the United State of America where “We the People” are in charge. We the People decide what’s best. And We the People are the foundation that secures the liberty of all by upholding the principles, ideals, and written promises in that sacred document of liberty.

This is why I am urging you to stand with Scott on June 28th. I hope you and our fellow Republican primary voters will send this good man to Congress. As I said, we need many Scott Kaspars in Washington who believe in America: believe in the promise of freedom that is the American ideal.

Please take some time to contribute to Scott's campaign by going to his [donation page](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=9e17d61d90&e=9931950ab1).

[I hope you’ll support Scott with as large a financial contribution as you can](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=2bf126152a&e=9931950ab1). But even if you cannot, please take some time to [fill out this form](https://kasparforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4e283db73c0929a02145e8702&id=765c055c0e&e=9931950ab1) to join his email list and let him know you want to help out.

I can promise you when Scott gets to Washington, he will stand for the Constitution. He will protect your liberty. And he will help restore our country to its promise of freedom and prosperity which we have enjoyed throughout our history.

Thank you,

| | | Derek, __Do you have a few moments? Our campaign has been making waves here in New Hampshire, leading in the polls and building support in every corner of the state. And I want to take the time to tell you what it’s all about - here’s just some of what I’m fighting for: **#1: It’s time we****MAKE OUR ECONOMY GREAT AGAIN****and combat the inflation that’s skyrocketing as a result of Biden and Hassan’s out-of-control spending.** The rising prices are at a 40-year high with no end in sight, and we have these Democrats in Washington to blame for their complete lack of fiscal discipline at a federal level. We need real solutions that both tackle the causes and provide immediate relief. As someone who balanced budgets here in NH, I’m ready to do just that. **#2: We need to Back the Badge and Support Our Law Enforcement now more than ever.** Violent crime is on the rise all across the country, and yet some of the radicals in Maggie Hassan’s party are calling for us to Defund the Police. I have always supported law enforcement, and will be a champion for them in the U.S. Senate. **#3: We can’t let Parents’ Rights end at their child’s classroom door.** Parents have the power to bring about political change, and here in New Hampshire, we listened to them with victories for School Choice and more. I will continue to stand up for parents in D.C., because unlike Maggie Hassan, I listen to their input instead of the demands of the teacher’s unions. **#4: It’s time we finally Secure the Border.** The results of Maggie Hassan’s support for the Biden Open Borders policies are being felt in New Hampshire everyday with a daily surge of fentanyl. We need to secure the border, finish building President Trump’s Wall, put America First, and keep our streets safe!****

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | Derek, Do you have a few moments? Our campaign has been making waves here in New Hampshire, leading in the polls and building support in every corner of the state. And I want to take the time to tell you what it’s all about - here’s just some of what I’m fighting for: #1: It’s time weMAKE OUR ECONOMY GREAT AGAINand combat the inflation that’s skyrocketing as a result of Biden and Hassan’s out-of-control spending. The rising prices are at a 40-year high with no end in sight, and we have these Democrats in Washington to blame for their complete lack of fiscal discipline at a federal level. We need real solutions that both tackle the causes and provide immediate relief. As someone who balanced budgets here in NH, I’m ready to do just that. #2: We need to Back the Badge and Support Our Law Enforcement now more than ever. Violent crime is on the rise all across the country, and yet some of the radicals in Maggie Hassan’s party are calling for us to Defund the Police. I have always supported law enforcement, and will be a champion for them in the U.S. Senate. #3: We can’t let Parents’ Rights end at their child’s classroom door. Parents have the power to bring about political change, and here in New Hampshire, we listened to them with victories for School Choice and more. I will continue to stand up for parents in D.C., because unlike Maggie Hassan, I listen to their input instead of the demands of the teacher’s unions. #4: It’s time we finally Secure the Border. The results of Maggie Hassan’s support for the Biden Open Borders policies are being felt in New Hampshire everyday with a daily surge of fentanyl. As a working mom, I know that some days are more of a challenge than others. So many working families I know are feeling the pressure of this time, from rising prices at the pump to juggling the realities of childcare and work.
As a member of the LGBTQ+ community, I understand what it means to be part of a community that is still fighting to be equal under the law.
As a pro-choice pastor, I’m committed to protecting reproductive rights and I’m dedicated to ensuring that everyone has the privacy to make choices about their health care.

subject: UPDATE: Halfway to our goal to close a climate loophole
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
We saw you hadn't submitted an official public comment yet.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=2&akid=12981%2E53494%2Eugu4wr) | We're partnering with 12+ climate groups to eliminate a loophole from the SEC's groundbreaking climate rule. **So far, more than 50,000 people have signed on—but we're only halfway to our goal and we're missing your signature.**

[**_The final deadline is this week—this is our last chance to get this over the finish line. Sign an official public comment telling the SEC to strengthen their new climate rule!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=3&akid=12981%2E53494%2Eugu4wr)
---

| [TAKE ACTION NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=4&akid=12981%2E53494%2Eugu4wr)
---
Friend,
Right now, public companies aren't required to tell investors about their climate risk—meaning that countless 401(k)s, pensions, and IRAs could be wiped out in a climate disaster.
The SEC just proposed a rule to require companies to disclose their climate vulnerability, greenhouse gas pollution, and their plan to protect investors. This is great progress—but there's a major problem.
The current draft of the rule only requires companies to disclose their Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions—giving them the chance to keep their Scope 3 emissions hidden. Here's what that means in plain English.
* **Scope 1** emissions are the pollution a company creates in its own operations—the pollution billowing from a factory's smokestacks, for example.
* **Scope 2** emissions are the pollution from the generation of purchased energy. If a factory buys power from a coal plant, the pollution from burning the coal will be accounted for.
* **Scope 3** emissions are the pollution from the rest of the company's activities—including use of the product they create. For example, if the factory in question is producing gasoline, its products will obviously release pollution—but under the current draft rule, they wouldn't have to disclose this.

Scope 3 emissions are often the vast majority of a company's pollution. Leaving disclosure of a large share of companies' pollution up to their own discretion leaves investors in the dark—and all of us vulnerable to a climate-related financial crash.
Luckily, the SEC has opened a public comment period, and we need to show massive support for including Scope 3 emissions in this groundbreaking policy.
[**_Will you join thousands of climate advocates from over a dozen climate groups across the country by signing an official public comment right now? We'll submit it directly to SEC decision-makers!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=5&akid=12981%2E53494%2Eugu4wr)
[SIGN ON](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=6&akid=12981%2E53494%2Eugu4wr)
---
Together,
Lena Moffitt

Peter, When I grew up, the veterans in my community were some of the strongest, bravest people I knew. I knew I wanted to be _just_ like them, so I worked my tail off to get into West Point and graduate to become a U.S. Army Captain. But no matter what you see in Top Gun, serving our country isn’t glamorous. It’s staying long nights out in the elements. It’s a mission where you don’t know what the next day will bring. Whether it’s swallowing your pride and putting your nose to the grindstone, or whether people see your hard work or not. _I may have hung up my uniform, but the work ethic, patriotism, and values of the military are as strong in me as ever before._

clean_body: | | | Peter, When I grew up, the veterans in my community were some of the strongest, bravest people I knew. I knew I wanted to be just like them, so I worked my tail off to get into West Point and graduate to become a U.S. Army Captain. But no matter what you see in Top Gun, serving our country isn’t glamorous. It’s staying long nights out in the elements. It’s a mission where you don’t know what the next day will bring. Whether it’s swallowing your pride and putting your nose to the grindstone, or whether people see your hard work or not. I may have hung up my uniform, but the work ethic, patriotism, and values of the military are as strong in me as ever before. | | My service inspired me to run for Congress and serve the great people of Georgia. And now, I want to inspire YOU to step up for the future you want. Every time I watch Democrat politicians speak, my heart aches for my fellow veterans and service members. The things we fought for - the things we were willing to give our lives for - they’re trying to destroy. Our own President even said that your God-given rights are “not absolute.” But just like when I joined the Army to protect our freedom, I won’t sit by idly while it’s under attack now. And I know you won’t either. Thank You, Jeremy Hunt | | Paid for by Jeremy for Georgia | | Contributions to this committee are not deductible as charitable contributions for Federal income tax purposes. name: Team Jayapal
subject: Making sure we're ready for our electoral work
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
#
Peter,
We’re nearing the end of June — that means a few things.
First, it means we’re heading into the summer months of a midterm election year. These will be critical for (1) Pramila’s re-election campaign in Washington’s 7th Congressional District, (2) our work to help elect Democrats in swing districts, so that we can hold onto our Democratic majority, and (3) Pramila’s continued work to elect people-first progressives, so we can grow support for bold, transformative policies in Congress.
It also means we’re headed to our end-of-quarter FEC filing deadline. It’s the second to last time before the general election that we’ll be publicly sharing our fundraising numbers. Influential folks in the media and Washington D.C. will look at our numbers to see the strength of Pramila’s progressive campaign.
[**To stay on track for the FEC deadline, we’re launching a mid-month goal to hit 1,250 donations before 11:59 p.m. on June 15. Can you chip in $3 to fuel Pramila’s electoral work and help us stay on track?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14383?refcode=em20220613-1345&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1345%2E420207%2E9EN-j3) _We’re currently 261 donations shy of our goal._
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14383?refcode=em20220613-1345&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1345%2E420207%2E9EN-j3)**
These upcoming deadlines are even more important because fundraising during the summer is notoriously hard — even during an election year. So, we really need to hit our goals this month, Peter.
And you know we rely on grassroots funding to run our campaign. Pramila would not be able to do this work without you.
The only way we can achieve our goals this year and in the future is if we hold our Democratic majority and grow our Congressional Progressive Caucus. Your support right now will help us do the critical electoral work in WA-7 and beyond.
[**So, Peter, can you contribute to Pramila’s campaign today and help us battle for control of Congress? We can only hit our mid-month goal with your help.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14383?refcode=em20220613-1345&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1345%2E420207%2E9EN-j3)
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220613-1345-footer&t=22&refcode2=1345_420207_9EN-j3&akid=1345%2E420207%2E9EN-j3)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, and small-dollar contributions sustain our movement for transformative change. To contribute by check, please address to Pramila for Congress, PO Box 21912, Seattle, WA 98111.

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14626?t=6&akid=3177%2E878179%2E86PwZs) It's official: With every vote counted and the results certified, our people-powered campaign is advancing to the TX-15 general election!

**But, it 's not all good news.** We just got word that my opponent from the primary is requesting a recount, which means before we can start preparing for the general election we need to hire lawyers, keep organizing, and ensure this recount is fair.

[**Will you chip in to our NEW Voter Protection Recount Fund and the Voter Protection Project to make sure we have the resources and support we need to keep up our momentum and get ready for the recount?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14626?t=7&akid=3177%2E878179%2E86PwZs) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Michelle Vallejo and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14627?t=8&akid=3177%2E878179%2E86PwZs)

[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14629?t=10&akid=3177%2E878179%2E86PwZs)

Look, I'm confident we won, and I'm not afraid of a recount. It will only show what we already know: **The voters of TX-15 are behind our grassroots campaign. In the primary runoff, my opponent was supported by outside groups and outspent us 3 to 1, but this people-powered campaign still won.** Now, I need your support more than ever. Recounts are expensive and we need your help to make sure this process is fair.

I stepped into this race because I believe that South Texans deserve more -- affordable health care, affordable college, higher wages, good-paying jobs, and investments that put people over profits. That's what it's going to take to get our economy back on track and keep our families safe.

South Texans need a fresh voice in order to hold this seat in November and I am honored that the people have chosen me to keep fighting for our pueblo and the chance to become the first woman to ever represent Texas's 15th Congressional District.

[**But with an expensive recount looming - not to mention the need to start getting ready for what will be the most competitive congressional race in Texas - we must ensure we have the resources we need to win. Will you split a donation with our Voter Protection Recount Fund and the Voter Protection Project to make sure that we do?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/14626?t=13&akid=3177%2E878179%2E86PwZs)

| | | Dear Peter,

Pride Month is a time for all of us – whether you’re LGBTQ+ or an LGBTQ+ ally – to commemorate and celebrate the massive steps we’ve taken toward inclusion and equality thanks to the tireless marching, organizing, and running for office undertaken by generations of brave activists.

But the fact remains: none of us are equal, until all of us are equal. Dozens of states across the country are still considering or are passing dangerous anti-LGBTQ+ legislation that rolls back the clock on equality and LGBTQ+ rights. It’s as important as ever to have leaders in Congress with a proven record of stepping up to protect equal rights.

In the Assembly, I’ve been proud to stand with LGBTQ+ Californians to advance and protect inclusion and equality, and I am honored to have the sole endorsement of Equality California. In Congress, you can be sure that I will continue to be the reliable ally that LGBTQ+ Californians deserve in Washington.

On behalf of all of us at Team Mullin, I want to wish you a Happy Pride Month.

Thank you,

Kevin Mullin
